weight.formula: gaugeStates(g).point resolved to the sample time

voteSupply.formula: the gauge's allocated weight supply at the sample time, the denominator of yield per weight

weightFlow.formula: W(t) - W(t-1h) resolved to t (allocations in minus out, decay removed)

feeYield.unit: token wei per weight wei x 1e24
feeYield.formula: delta of FeeDistribution.feeRewardPerVotingPower over the hour

incentiveRate.formula: sum of IncentiveStreaming rate of programs active at the sample time

yieldPerWeight.unit: token wei per weight wei per hour x 1e24
yieldPerWeight.formula: feeYield + sum(rate x active seconds in the hour) x 1e6 / allocated weight supply (reward contract totalSupply)

relayAllocatedAmount.formula: sum of allocations of relay-owned positions (relayConfig().tokenId)

allocationHhi.formula: 10000 x sum((a_i / sum a)^2) over the allocations a_i on the gauge

poolSwapFees.formula: delta of PoolTape.accumulators(pool).cumulativeFee over the hour (paid by swappers to the pool, LP-side)

poolSwaps.formula: delta of PoolTape.accumulators(pool).swapCount over the hour

stakedLiquidity.formula: CLPool.stakedLiquidity() at the sample block (in-range, staked in the gauge)

stakedShare.formula: stakedLiquidity x 1e6 / liquidity, floor; null when liquidity is 0

emissionsCredited.formula: delta of LeafVoter.gaugeStates(g).ceiling over the hour (settled reward share, after the gauge cap)

emissionsClaimed.formula: delta of LeafVoter.gaugeStates(g).claimed over the hour (minted to the gauge for its staked LPs)

emissionsForfeited.formula: delta of LeafVoter.gaugeStates(g).surplus over the hour (forfeited by the gauge)

emissionsClaimable.formula: ceiling - claimed - surplus at the sample block
